### Compare business health insurance for UK SMEs

Compare business health insurance for UK SMEs Compare business health insurance for UK SMEs and small companies. Employee medical cover from FCA-regulated brokers. Free quotes for teams from 2 employees. Compare Business Healthcover helps UK small and medium-sized employers compare business health insurance , SME health insurance , and employee medical cover from leading providers. The service is free and no-obligation. Group schemes are often available from just two employees . We are an introducer. FCA-regulated broker partners compare group private medical insurance (PMI) options so you can see cover levels, exclusions, and premiums before you decide. Why UK SMEs compare group health cover Reduce employee sick days with faster private treatment Attract and retain staff with a valued employee benefit Often a tax-efficient benefit for the company (confirm with your accountant) Flexible cover that can scale as your headcount grows Who we help Small companies and startups (typically 2–50 staff) Growing SMEs comparing or renewing group PMI Larger businesses needing corporate health insurance Self-employed owners and sole traders How to get an SME health insurance quote Complete the short enquiry form with company size, location, and the cover you need. A broker partner compares group schemes and explains options. There is no obligation to buy. Contact Compare Business Healthcover or call 01484 773038. Frequently asked questions What is business health insurance for SMEs? Business health insurance — also called group private medical insurance (PMI) — is an employee benefit arranged by an employer so staff can access private healthcare. For UK SMEs it can reduce sickness absence, support faster treatment, and strengthen recruitment. Schemes can often start from two employees. How many employees do I need for SME health insurance? Many group schemes are available from as few as two employees, so micro-businesses and growing SMEs can access cover as well as larger companies. Eligibility varies by insurer, company structure, and cover level. How much does SME health insurance cost? Cost depends on team size, employee ages, cover level, and insurer. SME schemes often start from a few pounds per employee per week. Comparing quotes from FCA-regulated brokers is the most reliable way to see the market for your business. Is business health insurance tax-efficient? Employer-paid group health insurance is usually treated as a business expense and is generally an allowable deduction for corporation tax. For employees, PMI is typically a taxable benefit in kind and reported via PAYE. Confirm the position with your broker or accountant. Is the comparison service free? Yes. Compare Business Healthcover is free for employers. If you take out a policy through a broker partner, they receive commission from the insurer — this does not increase the premium compared with going direct. Are you an insurer? No. Compare Business Healthcover is an introducer and comparison service operated by MASON & HALL DIGITAL LTD. Quotes and policies are arranged by FCA-regulated broker partners and/or insurers.

### Business health insurance guide for UK SMEs
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/health-insurance-guide

Business health insurance guide for UK SMEs Guide to business health insurance for UK SMEs. Learn about employee cover options, costs, tax benefits, and how to choose the right plan for your team. This guide explains how group private medical insurance works for UK employers: what it covers, how quotes are priced, and how to choose a scheme for your headcount. What is group health insurance? It is private medical cover arranged by an employer for employees (and sometimes dependants). It is not NHS care, and it is not the same as life insurance or income protection. What affects the price? Number of employees and age profile Level of cover (inpatient, outpatient, therapies, dental/optical extras) Excess, hospital list, and underwriting method Claims history on an existing scheme at renewal Next step Compare SME quotes or read the business health insurance blog . UK employers typically choose between small-company SME schemes, wider business group PMI, and corporate arrangements for larger workforces. All provide private medical cover; they differ in scale, underwriting, and administration. ## FAQs

Q: What is business health insurance for SMEs?
A: Business health insurance — also called group private medical insurance (PMI) — is an employee benefit arranged by an employer so staff can access private healthcare. For UK SMEs it can reduce sickness absence, support faster treatment, and strengthen recruitment. Schemes can often start from two employees.

Q: How many employees do I need for SME health insurance?
A: Many group schemes are available from as few as two employees, so micro-businesses and growing SMEs can access cover as well as larger companies. Eligibility varies by insurer, company structure, and cover level.

Q: How much does SME health insurance cost?
A: Cost depends on team size, employee ages, cover level, and insurer. SME schemes often start from a few pounds per employee per week. Comparing quotes from FCA-regulated brokers is the most reliable way to see the market for your business.

Q: Is business health insurance tax-efficient?
A: Employer-paid group health insurance is usually treated as a business expense and is generally an allowable deduction for corporation tax. For employees, PMI is typically a taxable benefit in kind and reported via PAYE. Confirm the position with your broker or accountant.

Q: Is the comparison service free?
A: Yes. Compare Business Healthcover is free for employers. If you take out a policy through a broker partner, they receive commission from the insurer — this does not increase the premium compared with going direct.

Q: Are you an insurer?
A: No. Compare Business Healthcover is an introducer and comparison service operated by MASON & HALL DIGITAL LTD. Quotes and policies are arranged by FCA-regulated broker partners and/or insurers.
